proceduralStep.para: Ensure aircraft is properly grounded with grounding strap connected
Verify all personnel are clear of propeller/rotor areas and engine intakes
Connect external ground power unit (GPU) if available, or ensure aircraft battery has adequate charge (minimum 24V for 28V systems, 110V for 115V systems)
Set battery master switch to ON position
Verify BAT BUS voltage indication on electrical synoptic or multifunction display
Select external power if connected and verify EXT PWR AVAIL indication
Close generator control breakers or switches as required for ground maintenance power configuration
Verify all essential buses are powered and avionics systems complete power-on BIT
Wait minimum 60 seconds for all systems to complete initialization before proceeding with maintenance tasks
Ensure all maintenance tasks are complete and all test equipment is disconnected
Close all access panels and doors unless further work is planned
Record all fault codes, test results, and maintenance actions in aircraft logbook and maintenance tracking system
Allow avionics systems to complete any ongoing data recording or memory writes (minimum 30 seconds)
Set all avionics master switches and display controls to OFF position
Open generator control breakers or switches
Disconnect external power if connected
Set battery master switch to OFF position
Verify all displays and indicators are dark (no power present)
Disconnect aircraft grounding strap and stow properly

proceduralSpec.proceduralTitle: Selective Power Application for Specific Systems

proceduralStep.para: When maintenance requires power to specific systems only, use the following selective power procedure
Complete steps 1-6 of Aircraft Power-Up Procedure (P001)
Identify circuit breaker panel or power distribution panel controlling target system
Close only the circuit breakers required for the system under maintenance
Leave all non-essential system breakers OPEN to minimize power consumption and reduce potential for inadvertent system activation
Apply power and verify only intended systems are energized
After maintenance, open all selective breakers and follow complete power-down procedure (P002)
